question: Who among the following was the author of 'Brihat Katha Kosh'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harisena**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harisena** is credited as the author of 'Brihat Katha Kosh'.
 
• He was an ancient Indian poet and author known for his contributions to Sanskrit literature.
 
• 'Brihat Katha Kosh' is a significant work that belongs to the genre of classical Sanskrit literature.
 
• The text is an extensive collection of tales and stories, showcasing the rich cultural and literary heritage of ancient India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kshemendra** was another prominent Sanskrit poet and writer, but he is not the author of 'Brihat Katha Kosh'.
 
• **Dandin** was known for his work 'Dashakumaracharita', a prose romance in Sanskrit.
 
• **Bhavabhuti** was a celebrated dramatist and poet, known for plays like 'Malatimadhava' and 'Uttararama-charita'.
 
• 'Brihat Katha Kosh' remains an important source for understanding the literary and narrative traditions of ancient India.
